anchor: of his own motion communicated the finding of the court
note: Of his own motion: on his own initiative. The finding is the court’s verdict.

anchor: each radically sharing in the rarer qualities of our nature
note: Radically: at root, thoroughly. Melville sees both men as rare, noble natures.

anchor: in consonance with the spirit of Captain Vere
note: Consonance: agreement, harmony, being in tune with.

anchor: the passion sometimes latent under an exterior stoical or indifferent
note: Latent: hidden. Stoical: calm, showing no feeling.

anchor: even as Abraham may have caught young Isaac
note: In Genesis, God told Abraham to sacrifice his son Isaac. Abraham obeyed, and at the last moment an angel stopped him.
source: The Bible (King James Version), Genesis 22:9-12, https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/10

note: Behest: a command, here the order God gave Abraham.

anchor: the sacrament, seldom if in any case revealed to the gadding world
note: Sacrament: a sacred rite. Gadding: wandering about idly, here the gossiping public.

anchor: holy oblivion, the sequel to each diviner magnanimity
note: Oblivion: forgetting. Magnanimity: greatness of soul.
Agony: extreme suffering of body or mind.
Revelation: something suddenly disclosed, here Vere’s anguished face.
